  # Pixel Orchard — Design and Frontend Studio

## Contact & Links
- **Location:** Riverton
- **Website / Portfolio:** [https://poor.example](https://poor.example)
- **Case studies:** [https://poor.example/work](https://poor.example/work)

---

## Summary
Pixel Orchard is a fictional one-person studio that designs and builds interfaces for small companies: marketing sites, dashboards and the occasional mobile app. The work runs from the first sketch to the deployed code.

---

## Skills & Tooling

### Frontend
- **Languages:** JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS
- **Frameworks:** React, Next.js, Vue.js
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS, CSS modules

### Design
- **Tools:** Figma, Inkscape
- **Strengths:** design systems, motion, accessible colour palettes

---

## Selected work
- **Orchard Board:** a planning dashboard for a fictional farm cooperative.
- **Lantern:** a booking site for a fictional evening language school.
